name: deployAr Precio a Medida for WooCommerce
author: deployAr

sections.description:
deployAr Precio a Medida for WooCommerce lets you assign custom price lists to WooCommerce user roles and apply percentage discounts by product category — no coding required.

Key features:

  • Price lists — create unlimited price lists and assign them to user roles. Each list stores a per-product price that overrides the public price for users with that role.
  • Role assignment with priority — a user can have multiple roles; the list with the highest priority is used. Drag-and-drop reordering in the admin.
  • Category discounts — define a percentage discount for any product category (including subcategories). The discount applies to all users unless they have a price list that takes precedence.
  • Flexible conflict resolution — when a product has both a list price and a category discount, choose between three strategies: list only, discount on top of list, or best-of (lowest price).
  • WooCommerce sale price handling — configure whether discounts apply to the regular price, the sale price, or not at all when a product is already on sale.
  • Crossed-out price — optionally show the regular price struck through next to the special price in product listings and on product pages.
  • Price simulator — preview what price any user (or a guest) would see for any product, without changing anything in the store.
  • Test mode — restrict special pricing to administrators while you verify the configuration.
  • HPOS and Cart/Checkout Blocks compatible — declared compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and the block-based cart and checkout.

This plugin is designed for new installations. There is no migration from other pricing plugins.

Precio a Medida Pro (separate add-on): an optional add-on from the same author, sold separately at https://deployar.ar/plugins/precio-a-medida-pro/. Everything described above works in this plugin on its own, with no limits and no license. This plugin never contacts any server: the Home screen only shows a link that opens when you click it.

Made with 🧉 and lots of code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the deployar-precio-a-medida folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active (WordPress asks for it when you activate the plugin).
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen. On a multisite network, activate it on each site, not network-wide.
  4. Go to Precio a Medida > Home: it explains what the plugin does and walks you through the first steps.
  5. Go to Precio a Medida > Price Lists to create your first price list.
  6. Go to Precio a Medida > Customers (tab By role) to assign the list to a user role.
  7. Go to Precio a Medida > Discounts to set up category discounts.
  8. Go to Precio a Medida > Settings to configure global options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce variable products?

Yes. Prices can be set per variation. When a variable product has no variation-level price in the list, no override is applied for that variation.

What happens when a user has multiple roles, each with a different list?

The list with the highest priority (lowest priority number) in the By role tab of Customers is used. You can reorder priorities by dragging rows.

Can I apply both a list price and a category discount to the same product?

Yes. The Settings screen lets you choose what happens when a product has both: use only the list price, apply the discount on top of the list price, or charge whichever is lower.

What happens when a product is already on sale in WooCommerce?

Three options are available in Settings: apply your discount to the regular price (capped at the sale price), apply the discount to the sale price, or skip the discount for products already on sale.

Will the plugin delete my data if I uninstall it?

Only if you enable Delete data on uninstall in Settings before uninstalling. By default, all data is preserved.

Does it work on a multisite network?

Multisite is not supported in version 1.0. You can activate the plugin on an individual site of a network, but network-wide activation is blocked with a message, because the lists and settings belong to each site.

Does it work with page caching?

Prices that depend on the logged-in user cannot be served from a full-page cache shared between users. If your site uses a page cache or a CDN, exclude the shop, product and category pages for logged-in users (WooCommerce already excludes the cart, checkout and account pages).

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and the block-based cart?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with both High-Performance Order Storage (custom order tables) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
